Garlic butter and parmesan.How to make it2 tbsp vegetable oil150g popping corn60g butter1 garlic clove40g parmesan1 bunch parsleyHeat the oil in a large pot with a lid, add the corn, cover and shake over medium heat until the popping slows.Melt the butter with the crushed garlic.Toss the popcorn with the garlic butter, finely grated parmesan, pepper, salt and chopped parsley.
